name: 人物多视角设定图
description: 游戏角色设定图：同一角色的正面 / 3-4 侧 / 正侧面 / 背面。配合角色锚点与参考图保证风格一致。

blocks.en: game character concept sheet, clean orthographic full-body figure, centered in each panel, identical scale, plain uniform background, even flat lighting
consistent cel-shaded vector illustration, crisp clean outlines, flat color fills, no gradient, no drop shadow
identical facial features, identical hairstyle, identical outfit, identical accessories and identical color palette in every panel

negative: photorealism, 3D render, celebrity, realistic human face, text, letters, watermark, logo, panel border, frame, split line, cropped body, different clothing, different hairstyle, cluttered background
notes: 工具配方：由「角色工作台」调用，不建议在普通批量生成里直接用。锚点由角色卡自动拼在提示词最前面。
